workLog.task: Measure the real scope of the problem before designing a fix
workLog.outcome: 473 of 943 committed session logs fail today's validator, concentrated in 2025-12 (268 of 277). Six logs crash it outright with AttributeError, reported as FATAL exit 2.

Refuted. The exemption comment blamed a schema move, but git log -S puts validationPassed and markdownLintRun at 2026-01-09 (#830), a month before the 2026-02-11 log they blocked. A date-versioned required-items set would not have unblocked the named case.

workLog.task: Split record validation from compliance-claim validation
workLog.outcome: Shape is a property of the record and always binds. The checklist is a claim about a session that already ended. A log this branch adds is validated as both; a log it only edits is validated as a record. Corpus failures drop 473 to 131, all 131 shape errors.

scripts/validation/session_scope.py, imported by the git hook and by the validator's --scope-from-git flag. Standard library only: the workflow's validate job installs no dependencies and runs a bare python3, so importing git_hook_policy would pull in PyYAML and fail. Verified the job has no uv and no Python setup step.

workLog.task: Close three holes found by probing the implementation
workLog.outcome: A pathspec suppresses rename detection (same rename reports A limited, R100 unlimited), so the diff runs unlimited and intersects in Python. An untracked log never appears in git diff, so ls-files decides tracked-ness. An unresolvable merge base returns every path as new, keeping a shallow checkout from becoming a bypass.

workLog.task: Fix an unrelated crash found while measuring
workLog.outcome: A checklist item holding a bare boolean raised AttributeError. Now a reported shape error naming the section, the item, and the type found.
